playstyle.identity: Jayce is a poke/all-in hybrid with two forms. His ranged form pokes with accelerated Q while hammer form bursts and knocks away enemies.
playstyle.howToPlay: Cannon (Ranged): Q shoots a shock blast. W creates a gate (Q through gate = accelerated). E speeds allies. Hammer (Melee): Q hammer slam. W AoE lightning. E knocks away. R swaps forms. Poke with cannon Q-E, then hammer all-in for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jayce spikes at level 3-6 with both forms and with lethality items. He's strongest mid-game at poking and bursting.

passive.name: Hextech Capacitor
passive.summary: Swapping forms grants movement speed and ghost.
passive.details: Each time Jayce transforms, he gains bonus movement speed and ignores unit collision for a short time.

abilities.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
abilities.summary: Hammer: leap and slam. Cannon: fire a shock blast.
abilities.details: Hammer: Jayce leaps to a target, dealing AoE damage and slowing. Cannon: Fire a blast that explodes on first enemy (accelerated through gate).

abilities.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
abilities.summary: Hammer: AoE lightning around you. Cannon: fire 3 fast shots.
abilities.details: Hammer: Deal magic damage around Jayce. Also passively restore mana on hit. Cannon: Fire 3 auto attacks rapidly at reduced damage.

abilities.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
abilities.summary: Hammer: knock enemy away. Cannon: create a speed gate.
abilities.details: Hammer: Knock an enemy back, dealing percent max health damage. Cannon: Create a gate that accelerates allied champions and Shock Blast.

abilities.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
abilities.summary: Swap between cannon (ranged) and hammer (melee) forms.
abilities.details: Jayce transforms, changing his abilities. Hammer gains bonus armor/MR. Cannon first attack shreds resistances.
